parole.significato: Swazi; a member of the largest ethnic group in Eswatini
parole.testo: Derived from English Swazi, from Zulu iSwazi, ultimately from Mswati, the regnal name of Mswati II, also known as Mswazi II. During his nineteenth-century reign, the name came to be applied to the people united under his rule. The corresponding Swazi forms are liSwati (“one Swazi person”) and emaSwa
